name: pickup_type_find_by_logical_name
description: Scans the pickup type table by logical name, writes the matched type index, and reports miss by writing zero and returning false.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent pickup.cpp source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja shows the original strcmp body inlined with flag-synthesis code; the source uses strcmp for tier C equivalence.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41dd60 validates a 40-entry g_PickupTypes scan, null logical-name skip, matched typeIndex write, true return, and miss path writing zero. The native pickup type smoke validates match and miss behavior while preserving the existing FindIndex coverage.
